components.title: Analytical procedures introduction
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Introductory statement confirming analytical procedures are compendial and per pharmacopoeial monographs. CONTRACT: Use exact source wording. PRESENTATION: Plain text string.

components.title: Analytical methods for excipients
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Table of analytical methods for each excipient. CONTRACT: Columns = Test | Method reference | Description. One row per excipient test. PRESENTATION: content with columns and rows.
